reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI listed among domestic reform tools
themes.definition: AI is named briefly in a list of technologies or reform measures within a national economic narrative, with no further discussion of AI.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI appears only as one item among digitization, crypto, IT or other reform tools.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that elaborate on AI policy, risks, or governance.
themes.boundary_cases: If the list item specifies a concrete national AI programme, code AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY instead.

examples.quote: embraced digitization, AI, and crypto as the tools of the future

themes.label: Equipping youth with AI skills
themes.definition: National efforts to equip young people with AI and IT skills as part of economic revival.
themes.inclusion: Include mentions of training youth or students in AI skills.
themes.boundary_cases: A brief list item on youth AI skills is coded here as well as AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION when no further detail is given.

examples.quote: equipping our youth with modern AI and IT skills

value.rationale: Both Pakistan passages mention AI only in passing inside a domestic economic reform narrative, alongside digitization, crypto and IT skills; neither discusses AI risks or governance.
